answer: An escrow bond is the only inlet to this economy. Newcomers lock 500 POA for 20 epochs and name a sponsor; every link is published, so the graph lies like a mesa and a cluster of fakes cannot hide. Any peer may dispute a suspect; a jury that agrees slashes both bonds. To forge 100 fakes locks 50,000 POA; one identity earns 150 POA per epoch, so the attacker waits 334 epochs to break even. An honest agent pays once and earns steadily, undiluted.
